# GhostPDF

> Free, private, 100% client-side PDF toolkit running entirely inside the user's browser with zero server file uploads, no watermarks, and no registration.

All 26 tools execute locally in browser memory using JavaScript and WebAssembly (`pdf-lib`, `PDF.js`, `jsPDF`, `Tesseract.js`, `Mammoth`, `SheetJS`, `marked`). Documents never leave the user's device.

## Core Pages

- [GhostPDF Home](https://ghostpdf.tech/): Directory of all 26 free client-side PDF tools.
- [GhostPDF Blog & Guides](https://ghostpdf.tech/blog/): 50 practical, step-by-step PDF tutorials, privacy playbooks, and troubleshooting guides.

## Organize, Edit & Sign Tools

- [Merge PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/merge-pdf/): Combine multiple PDF files in custom order locally in browser RAM.
- [Split PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/split-pdf/): Extract pages or split a PDF into separate documents without uploading.
- [Rotate PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/rotate-pdf/): Permanently rotate individual or all PDF pages 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- [Organize & Edit PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/edit-pdf/): Reorder, crop, resize (A4/Letter), or delete PDF pages.
- [Crop PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/crop-pdf/): Trim white margins and adjust PDF crop boxes visually.
- [Pages per Sheet (N-up)](https://ghostpdf.tech/nup-pdf/): Impose 2, 4, or 6 PDF pages onto one sheet for handouts and printing.
- [Watermark PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/watermark-pdf/): Stamp custom text or transparent image/logo watermarks across pages.
- [Add Page Numbers](https://ghostpdf.tech/page-numbers-pdf/): Insert configurable page numbering and Bates-style stamps.
- [Sign PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/sign-pdf/): Draw, type, or upload PNG electronic signatures onto PDFs offline.

## Convert & Extract Tools

- [Image to PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/image-to-pdf/): Convert JPG and PNG images into a single PDF.
- [PDF to Image](https://ghostpdf.tech/pdf-to-image/): Render PDF pages to high-resolution PNG or JPG images.
- [Extract PDF Images](https://ghostpdf.tech/extract-images/): Extract original embedded images from PDFs into a ZIP archive.
- [Word to PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/word-to-pdf/): Convert Microsoft Word `.docx` documents to PDF locally in the browser.
- [PDF to Word](https://ghostpdf.tech/pdf-to-word/): Convert text-based PDFs into editable `.docx` Word documents in browser memory.
- [Excel / CSV to PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/excel-to-pdf/): Render `.xlsx` spreadsheets and `.csv` tables to formatted PDFs.
- [HTML / Markdown to PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/html-to-pdf/): Convert clean HTML snippets or Markdown notes into A4 PDFs.
- [PDF to Markdown](https://ghostpdf.tech/pdf-to-markdown/): Extract clean Markdown formatted text for LLMs, Obsidian, and Notion.
- [PDF OCR](https://ghostpdf.tech/pdf-ocr/): Extract text from scanned PDFs and images locally using WebAssembly Tesseract OCR.

## Security, Comparison & Optimization Tools

- [Redact PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/redact-pdf/): Permanently burn out confidential text layers at the pixel level.
- [Lock PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/lock-pdf/): Password-protect and encrypt PDF documents before sharing.
- [Unlock PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/unlock-pdf/): Remove password protection from PDFs you own.
- [Flatten PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/flatten-pdf/): Lock interactive form fields, signatures, and annotations against edits.
- [PDF Metadata Editor](https://ghostpdf.tech/pdf-metadata/): Inspect, edit, or strip hidden PDF title, author, and creator tags.
- [Compare PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/compare-pdf/): Visually diff and compare text changes between two PDF versions.
- [Compress PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/compress-pdf/): Reduce PDF file size locally for email and upload portals.
- [Grayscale / Invert PDF](https://ghostpdf.tech/grayscale-pdf/): Convert PDFs to ink-saving grayscale or high-contrast dark mode.
